_readme: Patch archive names that RaceForge never writes customization art to (--art-letters). Names are relative to the client's Data folder and compared without regard to case, as Windows and the client do (patch-y.MPQ and Patch-Y.MPQ are one file). Add a name here when a new patch ships; build --patches-dir also refuses every name already in the realm's patch folder. --force-letters overrides both, with a warning.

taken.comment: Bleakhold realm: H L T V X Z, R (RaceForge's own patch-R.MPQ, rebuilt by the realm), Y (the HD pack) and the locale patch enUS-8
Reforged: mirrored from the partner project (the launcher's HD pack)
Tools/MapForge: staged in the server's extractor copy of the client only (server/extract/patch-5.MPQ)
